fields.notes: Wishbone B4 does NOT provide a formal verification plan. The categories above are derived from Chapter 3 (Bus Cycles), Chapter 4 (Registered Feedback Bus Cycles), Chapter 5 (Interfacing standard and pipelined peripherals), and Chapter 6 (Timing) of the spec, together with the RULEs scattered throughout.
verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Register access (read/write to all register fields; reserved-bit behavior)
Nominal transfer / transaction across the protocol's operating modes
Error and fault condition detection and handling
interoperability_test_matrix: Classic MASTER + Classic SLAVE (baseline B.3 / B.4).
Registered Feedback MASTER (Incrementing) + SLAVE supporting only Constant-address.
Multiple MASTERs sharing single SLAVE through arbiter.

extraction_hints: Look for coverage targets, vplan, regression policy.
